AP1.evidence: AP Data Center Policy 4.0 and a company announcement establish statewide policy and a Visakhapatnam project-region reference, not a canonical eligible candidate set.

AP2.evidence: Candidate parcels and canonical assessment-unit polygons/IDs are absent; the primary M_GW table is intentionally empty.

AP3.evidence: 71,384 coordinate-plausible observed rows and 2,746 station-location series are public, but stable IDs, QA, screens/layers, coordinate corrections, and post-August-2023 data are absent.

AP4.evidence: The 2024 GWRA provides annual estimated assessment totals, but no canonical unit polygons or monthly geocoded local dynamic forcing.

AP5.evidence: Official area/land-use and remote-sensing product families are identified; planning-ready crop-season demand, groundwater dependence, and node crosswalk are not built.

AP6.evidence: Official population and wastewater inventories provide context, but current service-area demand, abstraction, alternate-supply, reuse, and spatial crosswalk data require access.

AP7.evidence: Groundwater, reuse, desalination, and other supply pathways remain distinct but location-specific entitlement, capacity, commitment, quality, and conveyance are unverified.

AP8.evidence: PSCC-style semantics and official power-source families are identified; canonical model code/data, candidate set, interconnection, exact WSF, costs, demand, weights, and frozen result are absent.

AP9.evidence: No Andhra Pradesh groundwater model was estimated in this preflight, and time-resolved local forcing, vertical identity, and corrected state data are not yet sufficient. OCWD validates methodology only.

AP10.evidence: There is no common versioned site, grid, source, groundwater, agriculture, municipality, head, recharge, and extraction support panel.
